title: Gaps in a wing?
hook: A wing surface is made of many parts.

knows: Birds have body structures and interact with their surroundings.
doesNotKnow: The simplified fan shows neighboring feather vanes overlapping. That overlap helps make a continuous wing surface as the feathers spread; this sketch does not model airflow or flight forces.

misconception: The observed arrangement has a different effect than the one shown.
objective: A bird spreads its flight feathers. What does their overlap help form?

claims.text: A wing surface is made of many parts. A bird spreads its flight feathers. What does their overlap help form? The simplified fan shows neighboring feather vanes overlapping. That overlap helps make a continuous wing surface as the feathers spread; this sketch does not model airflow or flight forces.
claims.source: Unverified research starting point: OpenStax Biology 2e, Birds, https://openstax.org/books/biology-2e/pages/29-4-birds; species- or claim-specific citations require independent matching.

claims.text: The stage is a simplified schematic and the scenario is stipulated rather than observed.
A wing feather is missing from the middle of a spread fan. Which feature of the fan is interrupted? The missing vane interrupts the overlapping feather surface.
